findings.title: Operations Ask AI reads unbounded JSON before actor authorization
findings.evidence: Actual route with mocked downstream dependencies consumed the full 256 KiB sample without Content-Length; schema field limit did not bound body bytes. Deadline starts after parsing. No downstream DB or provider calls.
findings.impact: Application input resource boundary absent; deployed DoS and hosting limits not assessed.
findings.suggestedRepair: Use a bounded streaming JSON reader, resolve authorized scope before consumption where practical, and cover parsing with the deadline. Add overflow/cancellation and valid Unicode acceptance cases.
